collection.title: Subaru Impreza 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Subaru Impreza 2016 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Impreza which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: Subaru Impreza 2016 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
